pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pAdds FE storage, including additional storage when installed in a Flawless Calculator.$p$(l)Use$()$pCharge it through a compatible charger. Use it to read stored energy. Extra storage is not an energy generator and does not override a charger’s rate or native tier.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:calculators/installing)Using modules inside a Flawless Calculator$()$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pObtain this module: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.
